name: Plasm Capture
oracle_text: Counter target spell. At the beginning of your next first main phase, add X mana in any combination of colors, where X is that spell's mana value.
blocked_sentences: Counter target spell. At the beginning of your next first main phase, add X mana in any combination of colors, where X is that spell's mana value.

needs.what: A way to capture the mana value of a TARGET SPELL as it last existed on the stack (X included, copies included, uncounterable spells included) at resolution, before the counter, so a later delayed effect can read it: e.g. `snapshot` accepting a spell target (`{"op": "snapshot", "target": "t1", "as": "countered"}` resolving the stack ref to its StackItem and recording its mana value), read later as `{"mana_value_of": {"binding": "countered"}}` inside a `delayed_trigger` on `precombat_main` with `duration: "until_it_fires"` whose effect is `add_mana` with `split: [W,U,B,R,G]` and that amount.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `snapshot` with `target` reads `ctx.target_oids`, which drops stack refs, so it captures nothing for a spell target; `mana_value_of {"target": ...}` likewise reads object targets only, and the delayed trigger's context has no targets at all. `counter`'s `as` binds the oids of the cards that reached the graveyard: reading `mana_value_of {"objects": {"binding": ...}}` from that gives the graveyard card's mana value (X counted as 0), gives 0 for a countered copy or a spell that can't be countered (which per the rulings still yields the mana), and gives 0 if the card has left the graveyard before the next main phase. The rest of the card is expressible (delayed_trigger on precombat_main, add_mana split), so this value is the only missing piece.
